requirements.title: GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE assigns VALUE and LENGTH from environment state
requirements.definition: VALUE receives the specified environment variable value or all blanks, and LENGTH receives that value length or zero according to environment existence, value presence, and environment-variable support.

requirements.title: GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE STATUS uses the standard result codes
requirements.definition: STATUS is zero for existing variables with no value, successful assignment, or absent VALUE; -1 for too-short VALUE; 1 for nonexistence; 2 for no environment-variable support; and processor-dependent values greater than 2 for other errors.

pending.GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE-STATUS-zero-cas: Guarded plan probes a candidate NAME with VALUE absent and STATUS initialized to -9999; branch STATUS==0 records only that the zero-status branch was observed, then separately checks ERRMSG unchanged with a nonblank sentinel, without claiming which zero-case supplied the branch.
pending.GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE-STATUS-minus-on: Guarded plan first probes a candidate NAME with VALUE absent to obtain STATUS and LENGTH sentinels; branch STATUS==0 with LENGTH>0 makes a second call using a VALUE buffer shorter than LENGTH and asserts STATUS==-1, while all other branches make no truncation claim.
pending.GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE-STATUS-one-for-: Guarded plan probes a candidate NAME with VALUE, LENGTH, and STATUS sentinels; branch STATUS==1 asserts only the specified nonexistence effects VALUE all blanks and LENGTH==0, without requiring that this branch occur for every processor.
pending.GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE-STATUS-two-for-: Guarded plan probes a candidate NAME with VALUE, LENGTH, and STATUS sentinels; branch STATUS==2 asserts only the unsupported-environment effects VALUE all blanks and LENGTH==0, without requiring that this branch occur for every processor.
pending.GET_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE-STATUS-greater-: No portable oracle may compare other-error STATUS values beyond the greater-than-two class stated by the source; the guarded probe records positivity only for such a branch and makes no VALUE, LENGTH, or message-text claim.
